name: @celestia/jupiter
description: Jupiter — the framework-agnostic TypeScript client SDK (docs/NAMING.md, docs/CLIENT-SDK.md). Owns the Atlas transport (colyseus is contained in europa) + the netcode (ganymede: prediction/reconciliation/interpolation) and exposes a renderer-agnostic facade: the game touches ONLY Jupiter — never colyseus, never a wss URL. Mirrors the Godot/GDScript Jupiter on the shared @celestia/norma wire contract.
